items.title: Block 发布全双工语音模型 Dessa，只用语音从零训练
items.summary: Block 的 AI 研究实验室发布 Dessa：一个全双工的语音到语音模型，能边听边说，不使用任何文本或预训练模型、只用人类对话录音从零训练，训练只用了一台 NVIDIA GB200 NVL72，并可在 MacBook Pro M4 Max 或更高配置上本地运行。目前只公开了演示录音和候补名单，并向少量 AI 安全研究者提供早期访问；对做语音 Agent 的开发者来说，这是“绕开 ASR→LLM→TTS 级联”路线的一个新样本，值得关注后续开放情况。

evidence.quote: We trained Dessa from scratch on nothing but human conversation. Sounds! No text, no pretrained models.
It’s full-duplex, so it listens and talks at the same time, like you do.
And it runs locally on a MacBook Pro M4 Max or better.
And we figured out how to train Dessa on only one NVIDIA GB200 NVL72.
We’re giving a small group of AI safety researchers early access to find the risks we haven’t anticipated.

items.title: llama.cpp 合入 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 支持
items.summary: llama.cpp 合并了 PR #31086，新增 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash（deepseek41 架构）的模型转换与推理支持，其中 Engram 表转为 BF16。想在本地用 GGUF 跑 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的开发者，可以更新到包含该提交的版本试用。

evidence.quote: deepseek41 : remove MXFP8, convert the Engram table to BF16

items.title: Together AI 开源反“AI 味”设计技能 Hallmark
items.summary: Together AI 开源 Hallmark，一个适用于 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 和 OpenCode 的网页设计 skill：从主题库中挑选三个主题，围绕访客要完成的任务搭页面，并在真实浏览器里检查“每个标题上方都有 eyebrow 标签”之类的机器生成痕迹。和 Impeccable 定位相近，想让 Agent 生成的页面少点模板感可以对比试用。

evidence.quote: A design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode that refuses to look AI-generated.

It deals three themes from a catalog of forty-eight materials, builds the page around what the visitor came to do, and lints the result in a real browser against the tells that read as machine-made: the eyebrow above every heading

items.title: 开源桌面 Agent Cindy：在本地组合 Claude Code 与 Codex
items.summary: makecindy/cindy 是一个在本机运行、使用真实文件和已登录应用的开源 AI Agent 客户端，首批支持的 harness 是 Claude Code 和 Codex，任务中途可切换模型和 harness，工作区、记忆、skills 和工具保持不变。注意开源的是客户端，后端服务在另一个未包含在此仓库中的代码库里。

evidence.quote: Cindy runs locally on your own machine, using your real files and logged-in apps. The first supported harnesses are Claude Code and Codex
Models and harnesses mix freely and can switch mid-task while your workspace, memory, skills and tools stay continuous
Not in this repo: the backend service lives in a separate repository and is not part of this monorepo.

items.title: Apollo 首席经济学家：科技行业之外尚无 AI 回报迹象

evidence.quote: Revenue per worker is rising for the Mag 7 but is flat for the S&P 493, see the first chart below. Profit margins are rising for the Mag 7 but are flat for the S&P 493
And there are still no signs of AI boosting productivity growth
